info.name: Cancel Fraud Order by Order Number

items.docs:
If an order is suspected to be fraudulent, it is immediately placed on hold for verification. After verification, if its confirmed as fraudulent, this endpoint is used to cancel the order by order number.

**Note**: If you do not have an order number, use the corresponding order ID-based endpoint - `POST /orders/{orderId}/actions/fraud-cancel`.

If an order is suspected to be fraudulent, it is immediately placed on hold for verification. After verification, if it is confirmed as non-fraudulent, this endpoint is used to release the order from hold, by order number so that it can be processed.

**Note**: When you do not have an order number, use the corresponding order ID-based endpoint - `POST /orders/{orderId}/actions/fraud-release`.

info.name: Cancel Fraud Order by Order ID

params.name: orderId
params.description: 24-character system-generated order ID returned in the response of Create Order - `POST /orders` endpoint.
